typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		sbscrbrId as string,
		currentAdvocate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileNurseDetails
FlatFileNurseDetails derive(sbscrbrId = sbscrbrId) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount derive(Create_Date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		CAREGUIDE_ND_SubscriberID as string,
		CAREGUIDE_ND_USDomainID as string,
		CAREGUIDE_ND_Create_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CAREGUIDE_ND_SubscriberID = sbscrbrId,
		CAREGUIDE_ND_USDomainID = currentAdvocate,
		CAREGUIDE_ND_Create_Date = Create_Date)) ~> PDSCAREGUIDEMEMBERSTAGING
